items.title: Strategy (MSTR) Joins BlackRock And Coinbase In Bitcoin Security Consortium
items.summary: Strategy (NasdaqGS:MSTR) has joined BlackRock, Coinbase, and other industry players to form the Bitcoin Security Consortium. The consortium is focused on strengthening Bitcoin against potential quantum computing threats. Members have committed a combined US$15 million to support research and development of quantum resistant security measures.
